verdict.rationale: incident.io publishes a documented public REST API (api.incident.io) with API-key auth and downloadable OpenAPI specs (per-tag OpenAPI 3.0.3 JSON verified live), plus 550+ API-reference doc pages, enabling programmatic/agentic control of incidents, alerts, schedules, workflows etc. Missing for 10: a single consolidated OpenAPI root file (only per-tag specs found) and independent third-party developer testimonials on API robustness.
